evidence: The body first calls the predicate context_status_ids_13_0_18_equal_4_8_2 and rejects when false, then reads the supplied context's status at +8 and requires value 11 before consulting a global lookup and converting its result to a bounded code; invalid paths return 0xffffffff (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0171.c:49169-49201). Three callers use the returned value as a code/result rather than as a boolean (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0017.c:28342-28346; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0093.c:15827-15831).

The body fetches context status ID 0x13 (decimal 19), requires its low byte to equal 4, then checks global state bits 54 and 55 and returns 0 or -2 (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0100.c:49701-49731). Callers store the result in status/result slots, consistent with a validation code (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0113.c:9642-9646; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0117.c:11544-11548).

The body examines byte +7 of the second argument and tail-dispatches to check_attribute_context_value_supported when nonzero, otherwise to a related check helper (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0056.c:14296-14303). Callers pass an attribute/context value and a temporary output slot, then store/use the returned result (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0036.c:41927-41931; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0086.c:31429-31433).

The body clears three RTTs reward-state globals, initializes 34 fixed-size 16-byte records to zero/default values, sets a global pointer/state sentinel, and tail-calls load_rtts_milestone_rewards_config (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0032.c:47164-47197). It is invoked as part of both RTTs data-subsystem and RTTs attribute-subsystem initialization (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0033.c:46023-46027; decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0033.c:49847-49851).

The body initializes fields in a newly supplied 0x28-byte object, stores it in a global panel slot, creates/zeros a 0x10-byte auxiliary object, performs panel setup, then tail-calls initialize_rtts_minigames_panel (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0053.c:11182-11213). The caller allocates 0x28 bytes and stores the returned object pointer in its own object (decompiled/main/decompiled/main/main_0076.c:21024-21028).
